description: Protezione Civile Trapani is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by provincia.trapani.sitr.it. In the new Service prepared by the Regional Province of Trapani in which the data relating to Civil Protection can be viewed, with the aim of offering useful support for the planning and management of emergencies that follow the occurrence of catastrophic events. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Civil Protection Trapani" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include humanGeographicViewer. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
